import BusyBeaver.ZFC.DirtyReset254

namespace ResetAudit
open SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC
open Code254 Enum254 EnumStackBarrier254 EnumStackCount254 DirtyReset254

example (n t stack d h : Nat) (hn : n ∈ [0, 1, 2, 4, 5, 6]) :
    EnumSafeStart254.HaltsFrom ⟨0, n, t, stack, d, h⟩ ↔ C254 F :=
  six_dirty_starts_iff n t stack d h hn

example (n t stack d h : Nat) (hn : n ∈ [0, 1, 2, 4, 5, 6]) :
    ¬ EnumSafeStart254.HaltsFrom ⟨0, n, t, stack, d, h⟩ ↔ ¬ C254 F :=
  not_congr (six_dirty_starts_iff n t stack d h hn)

example (t stack d h : Nat) :
    EnumSafeStart254.HaltsFrom ⟨0, 0, t, stack, d, h⟩ ↔ C254 F :=
  zero_start_iff ⟨t, stack, d, h⟩

example (t stack d h : Nat) :
    EnumSafeStart254.HaltsFrom ⟨0, 1, t, stack, d, h⟩ ↔ C254 F :=
  one_start_iff ⟨t, stack, d, h⟩

example (t stack d h : Nat) :
    EnumSafeStart254.HaltsFrom ⟨0, 2, t, stack, d, h⟩ ↔ C254 F :=
  two_start_iff ⟨t, stack, d, h⟩

example (t stack d h : Nat) :
    EnumSafeStart254.HaltsFrom ⟨0, 4, t, stack, d, h⟩ ↔ C254 F :=
  four_start_iff ⟨t, stack, d, h⟩

example (t stack d h : Nat) :
    EnumSafeStart254.HaltsFrom ⟨0, 5, t, stack, d, h⟩ ↔ C254 F :=
  five_start_iff ⟨t, stack, d, h⟩

example (t stack d h : Nat) :
    EnumSafeStart254.HaltsFrom ⟨0, 6, t, stack, d, h⟩ ↔ C254 F :=
  six_start_iff ⟨t, stack, d, h⟩

-- The eight-row witness retains every original bad field in the exact tail.
example (t stack d h : Nat) :
    SafeStack (P (wal d h) (P t stack)) 8 (axStack d h h 0 0 t stack) :=
  ax_eight_prefix t stack d h

example (t stack d : Nat) : EnumSafeStart254.HaltsFrom ⟨0, 3, t, stack, d, 1⟩ :=
  three_cache_one_halts t stack d

example (hn : ¬ C254 F) (t stack d : Nat) :
    ¬ (EnumSafeStart254.HaltsFrom ⟨0, 3, t, stack, d, 1⟩ ↔ C254 F) := by
  intro he
  exact hn (he.mp (three_cache_one_halts t stack d))

example (t stack d : Nat) :
    EnumSafeStart254.HaltsFrom ⟨0, 3, t, stack, d, 0⟩ ↔ C254 F :=
  three_zero_cache_iff ⟨t, stack, d, 0⟩ rfl

-- Exact small syntax controls; no numeric test fuel is present.
example : commands 5 = [.mp 0, .mp 0] := commands_five
example : commands 6 = [.ax 0 0 0 0] := commands_six
example : credit 7 = 1 := credit_seven

end ResetAudit
